pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
